title: Foreign ATM withdrawal fees for Light Blue Account
summary: For the Light Blue Account, Rho-Bank provides 2 free foreign ATM cash withdrawals per month (per-withdrawal; unused allowances don’t roll over). After those 2 are used, each additional foreign ATM withdrawal is charged a $4.00 fee for the rest of that month, regardless of the withdrawal amount.
faqs: How many foreign ATM withdrawals are free each month on the Light Blue Account?
